raw_glosses: (pronominal, figurative) to immerse oneself (to become completely involved) [with em or dentro de ‘in something’]

unused_menu_senses.translation: to immerse oneself (to become completely involved)

canonical_example.text: Esse comentário não joga bem com a sua reputação de imparcial.
canonical_example.translation: This comment doesn’t go well with your reputation of impartiality.

raw_glosses: (intransitive) to match; to go with (to form a good combination with) [with com ‘someone/something’]

unused_menu_senses.translation: to match; to go with (to form a good combination with)

canonical_example.text: Joguei no amor e acabei levando uma facada nas costas.
canonical_example.translation: I placed a bet on love and ended up being stabbed in the back.
